description: 4-AI + 4-DI + 4-DIO remote Ethernet I/O, Modbus/TCP. AI FC04: AI_rawValue (512-515), AI_scaledValue u32 word-swapped (520-527), AI_rawValueMin (528-531), AI_rawValueMax (532-535), AI_scaledValueMin (536-543), AI_scaledValueMax (546-553), AI_status (576-579). AI FC03: AI_mode ch0-3 (544-547), AI_burnoutValue u32 ch0-3 (560-567). DI FC02: DI_status (0-7), DI_counterOverflowFlag (1000-1007). DI FC04: DI_counterValue byte-swapped u32 (16-31). DO FC01: DO_status (0-3), DO_pulseStatus (16-19). DO FC03: DO_all_status (32), DO_pulseCount ch0-3 (36-39), DO_pulseOnWidth unit 1ms (52-55), DO_pulseOffWidth unit 1ms (68-71).
